notes.title: Update 6
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
- Characters shaking intensely at low FPS (below 20) - Fixed
- Other players (COOP) not getting targeted by Target Lock - Fixed

Those are currently all the known bugs. If you discover any, makes sure to let me know by either posting in the Community Hub, or Emailing me - amel.gamedev@gmail.com


General Improvements:
- New Camera Mode
Optional Centered camera, in addition to Shoulder views. To switch camera modes, press C on keyboard. I Don't remember the Gamepad button for this, check out the Controls section in the Menu.

- Physics Improved
Made smoother and more pleasant

- AI Improved
Increased Aggression for some of the AI, since the Lower Tier NPCs most of the time weren't attacking the player, which was too easy and boring. Now should be a little harder.

notes.title: Update 5 (FPS Lock Options)
notes.notes:
In settings, you can change the FPS Lock. 
Default and recommended is 60, but you can change it to 120 or Unlocked. 

Physics also updated, to work properly with any FPS.   

IMPORTANT NOTE! 
If you had launched the game before this update, wrong fps lock setting might have been saved. Just enter the settings menu Video section (where FPS Lock option is), and press Apply (Y key).  
You probably don't have to do this, because I added code to make sure it applies the new correct setting automatically, but wasn't able to Test this, so adding this note just in case.

notes.title: BIG Update (No 4)
notes.notes:
Ragdoll Playground

Fall off Giant Staircases crash into a Glass Pit, check out our Cage Physics. Just come and enjoy the satisfying sounds of your characters head getting Bashed all around.




Challenge Mode


Do you have what it takes, to defeat 18 thugs, who get progressively stronger? Come to our Fully Destructible Rooftop Club and find out!




Target Lock


The new Target Lock feature will help you painlessly get used to the game, if you are a beginner. Make sure to check out the Tutorial, to learn how this works.




Engine Upgrade


The Engine used to develop the game has been Upgraded. This means Improved Performance, Better and more Stable Physics, and the ability to deliver Future Updates quicker!
